name: Cassia 1 XL
notes: After the Casio CZ-1 manual: 4 voices (8 with one line), two lines (1, 1 + 2, 2, 1 + 1'), all eight waveforms (saw, square, pulse, double sine, saw-pulse; resonance I, II, III) and a second one on every other cycle, DCO, DCW and DCA envelopes of six steps (three to the sustain, three after it), key follow, velocity, aftertouch, vibrato with delay, ring and noise modulation.
